from experiments.norman006 import inheritance
from flywheel import retention
root=Path.cwd(); base=root/'evidence/cycle-006'; out=base/'acquired-scientific-operator';out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
before=json.loads((base/'norman-development-constructor-001c-run/artifacts/ARTIFACT.json').read_text());after=json.loads((base/'norman-repair-constructor-002b-mapped-run/artifacts/ARTIFACT.json').read_text());search=json.loads((base/'norman-development-constructor-001c-run/artifacts/SEARCH.json').read_text())
r=inheritance.acquire(before,after,search,base/'verifier-symmetry-original/ADJUDICATION.json',base/'verifier-symmetry-mapped-003-run/artifacts/ADJUDICATION.json',root)
ident=retention.store(out/'memory',r); duplicate=retention.store(out/'memory',r);assert ident==duplicate
conditions={'representation':'single-intervention-panel-means','unordered_simultaneous_inputs':True,'gene_axis_available':True,'cell_line':'THP-1','perturbation':'CRISPR-cas13'}
generated=inheritance.retrieve_and_generate(out/'memory',conditions,root,count=8);ordinary=inheritance.ordinary_generate([r],root,count=8)
assert generated['candidates'][0]['generated']==ordinary[0]['generated']
for name,value in [('CAPABILITY.json',r),('RETRIEVAL_AND_GENERATION.json',generated),('ORDINARY_EQUIVALENT.json',ordinary)]:
 (out/name).write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'record_id':ident,'duplicate_idempotent':True,'fresh_related_configurations':len(generated['candidates'][0]['generated']['configurations']),'ordinary_identical_content_and_generation':True,'scope':'Functional generative acquisition only; fresh target predictions and advantage unrun.'}))
